scope: One-step ordinary43body Rain fixture; history of final relaxation phase only. Not physical qualification or proof of infinite-time convergence/divergence.
protocol: No-op diagnostic of previous contact-metric candidate. Preserve exact convergence criterion, physical calculations, inputs and128wave cap. Record final relaxation pass residual at16 fixed checkpoints and label the largest quantized velocity update (resolution1/32767; label tie breaks by larger key). Joint key=i+1; contact key=32768+slot. Extra filter-only fields frame_a_rotation/frame_b_rotation/target_rotation/weld_angular_impulse/perp_impulse carry history. Require body stream and complete captured semantic state exact versus parent except these declared fields using existing occupied-order audit. This distinguishes slow decay from a plateau; it does not prove an infinite-time cycle or qualify physics. No candidate change or cap increase.

probe.scope: One step convergence discriminator only; not Rain physical acceptance

history.scope: No-op final-relaxation wave history. Label ranking quantized to1/32767; exact norms and convergence policy unchanged. Does not establish an infinite-time cycle.

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,shutil,hashlib,json,sys
arm=sys.argv[1]
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
shader=Path('shaders/physics/solve.wgsl')
original=(root/'original-solve.wgsl').read_bytes()
assert shader.read_bytes()==original
try:
 shader.write_bytes((root/f'{arm}-solve.wgsl').read_bytes())
 with (root/f'{arm}-build.log').open('w') as log:
  r=subprocess.run(['cargo','build','--release','--lib','--features','replay-diagnostics'],env=__import__('os').environ|{'CARGO_BUILD_JOBS':'1'},stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 (root/f'{arm}-build-exit.json').write_text(json.dumps({'exit':r.returncode}))
 if r.returncode:raise SystemExit(r.returncode)
 shutil.copy2('target/release/libgpu_physics.a',root/f'{arm}-libgpu_physics.a')
finally:
 shader.write_bytes(original)
 (root/f'{arm}-restoration.json').write_text(json.dumps({'source_restored':shader.read_bytes()==original,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest()}))

with (out/'state.txt').open('w') as stdout,(out/'run.log').open('w') as stderr:r=subprocess.run(command,env=env,stdout=stdout,stderr=stderr)

for j in filters:
 assert j['revolute_axes_step']==1 and f(j['weld_linear_impulse'][0])==8
 values.append([f(x) for x in j['spring_angular_impulse']+j['motor_angular_impulse']+j['angular_impulse'][:2]]);caps.append(f(j['weld_linear_impulse'][1]))
assert len(set(caps))==1
passes=[]
for i,(count,vel,imp) in enumerate(zip(*values)):
 assert all(math.isfinite(x) for x in [count,vel,imp]) and int(count)==count and 2<=count<=128 and vel>=0 and imp>=0
 passes.append({'substep':i//2,'phase':'bias' if i%2==0 else 'relax','iterations':int(count),'last_velocity_change':vel,'last_impulse_change':imp,'last_change_below_threshold':max(vel,imp)<=1e-5})
rows=[t.split() for t in (out/'state.txt').read_text().splitlines()];assert len(rows)==42 and {int(t[0]) for t in rows}=={0} and len({int(t[1]) for t in rows})==42 and all(len(t)==16 and all(math.isfinite(float(x)) for x in t[2:]) for t in rows)
initial={int(t[1]):list(map(float,t[2:15])) for t in map(str.split,(p/'hip-initial.txt').read_text().splitlines())};getters={int(t[1]):list(map(float,t[2:])) for t in map(str.split,(out/'run.log').read_text().splitlines()) if t and t[0]=='replay-initial'}
pack=lambda x:struct.pack('<'+'f'*len(x),*x);assert set(initial)==set(getters) and all(pack(initial[k])==pack(getters[k]) for k in initial)
result={'status':'converged' if caps[0]==0 else 'nonconverged','initial_getters_exact':True,'passes':passes,'nonconverged_pass_count':int(caps[0]),'stop_expansion':caps[0]!=0,'scope':'One step convergence discriminator only; not Rain physical acceptance'}
assert caps[0]>=sum(not p['last_change_below_threshold'] for p in passes)
(out/'validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2));print(json.dumps(result,indent=2),flush=True)
if caps[0]:raise SystemExit(1)

(out/'history-validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2));assert body_exact and diff is None
